name: 68059 · Springfield, NE
findings: ZIP 68059 (Springfield) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68059 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68059 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
